title: Beatrix and the Cover
author: Astrid Fairweather
blurb: Theo Eriksen, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
